releaseNotes.zh-CN: 密码记事本首次公开预览：自定义分类、游戏/网站链接与备注，每个条目支持多组账号密码；分别复制账号或密码，默认 *** 隐藏，显示后 30 秒或失焦自动隐藏。支持当前分类/全部分类 TXT 明文导出，导出前确认风险。本机数据使用 Windows 当前用户 DPAPI 加密及原子保存。需要实现通用文件选择与弹窗接口的新版工具箱构建，早期同版本 0.3.4-alpha 可能缺少这些服务。
releaseNotes.en-US: First public Password Notes preview: categories, game/site links and notes, multiple accounts per entry, separate copying and masked passwords with explicit reveal and timed/blur hiding. Export the selected category or all categories to plaintext TXT after confirmation. User-scoped Windows DPAPI protects local storage with atomic saves. Requires generic file and popup host services; early 0.3.4-alpha builds may lack them.
